rationale.H001: Low layoffs and stronger activity preserve the soft-landing path, but the sharp ISM prices reading prevents an upgrade.
rationale.H002: 197K initial claims, lower insured unemployment, stronger new orders/employment, and +0.9% August construction modestly reduce near-term delayed-contraction weight; JOLTS/confidence softness still keeps the branch material.
rationale.H003: Strong activity coexists with ISM prices 77.9 and slow supplier deliveries, modestly strengthening the inflation/policy-constraint branch; the P000030 miss and survey-to-realized-price gap cap the increase.
rationale.H004: No new output-per-input or productivity evidence.
